dedupe_keys.name: gefahrenhinweiskarte sachsen atlas der hochwassergefahrdung in sachsen

description: Gefahrenhinweiskarte Sachsen (Atlas der Hochwassergefährdung in Sachsen) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The hazard warning map shows floodplains and intensities (water depth or specific runoff) in extreme floods for the Elbe river and the waters I. Order in Saxony in an overview scale (1:100.000) with a data level from 2004. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Hazard warning map Saxony (Atlas of flood risk in Saxony)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Umwelt, opendata, Interaktive Karte, Schadenpotential, Gefahrenhinweiskarte. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
